entities.summary: Vilhelm Storm  was a Norwegian zoologist and curator at the Royal Norwegian Society of Sciences and Letters (DNKVS). He is known for his pioneering research on the marine life of the Trondheimsfjord, particularly in the deep waters of the fjord, where he made contributions to the understanding of its rich biodiversity.
